tasks.label: _start/hardware-bridge-debug-enabled
args: echo '[task-start] _start/hardware-bridge-debug-enabled'; echo '[task-ready] _start/hardware-bridge-debug-enabled'; exec ./scripts/run_ros2_uv.sh ros2 launch hardware_bridge hardware_bridge.launch.py params_file:=${input:hardwareParamsFile} debug_mask:=1 debug_echo_decimation:=1 enabled:=true

tasks.label: _start/hardware-debug-monitor
args: echo '[task-start] _start/hardware-debug-monitor'; echo '[task-ready] _start/hardware-debug-monitor'; exec ./scripts/run_ros2_uv.sh ros2 topic echo /finsrov/hardware/thruster_cmd_echo --full-length

tasks.label: _start/perception-rgb
args: echo '[task-start] _start/perception-rgb'; echo '[task-ready] _start/perception-rgb'; exec ./scripts/run_ros2_uv.sh ros2 launch perception refractive_apriltag.launch.py detector_params:=${input:apriltagRgbDetectorParams} refractive_params:=${input:apriltagRgbRefractiveParams}

tasks.label: _start/perception-monitor
args: echo '[task-start] _start/perception-monitor'; echo '[task-ready] _start/perception-monitor'; exec ./scripts/run_ros2_uv.sh ros2 run perception perception_monitor

tasks.label: _start/fusion
args: echo '[task-start] _start/fusion'; echo '[task-ready] _start/fusion'; exec ./scripts/run_ros2_uv.sh ros2 launch state_estimation state_fusion.launch.py params_file:=${input:fusionParamsFile}

tasks.label: _start/controller-node
args: echo '[task-start] _start/controller-node'; echo '[task-ready] _start/controller-node'; params_input='${input:controllerProfileFile}'; config_dir='src/motion_control/config/FinsROV'; if [ -z "$params_input" ]; then params_file="$config_dir/ppo_control_for_pose_dr.yaml"; elif [ -f "$params_input" ]; then params_file="$params_input"; elif [ -f "$config_dir/$params_input" ]; then params_file="$config_dir/$params_input"; else echo "[task-error] controller params file not found: $params_input" >&2; echo "[task-error] searched: $params_input and $config_dir/$params_input" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec ./scripts/run_ros2_uv.sh ros2 launch motion_control motion_controller.launch.py params_file:=$params_file

tasks.label: _terminal/set-param
args: source ./scripts/source_ros2_uv.sh && echo '[task-start] _terminal/set-param' && echo '[task-ready] _terminal/set-param' && echo 'ROS2 set-param terminal: e.g. ros2 param set /hardware_bridge enabled true' && exec bash -i

tasks.label: _terminal/goal
args: source ./scripts/source_ros2_uv.sh && echo '[task-start] _terminal/goal' && echo '[task-ready] _terminal/goal' && echo 'ROS2 goal terminal: e.g. ros2 run motion_control send_position_goal --frame controller_world --x 2.0 --y -0.3 --z 0.0' && exec bash -i

tasks.label: _terminal/action
args: source ./scripts/source_ros2_uv.sh && echo '[task-start] _terminal/action' && echo '[task-ready] _terminal/action' && echo 'ROS2 action terminal: ready for manual commands.' && exec bash -i

tasks.label: _terminal/cancel
args: source ./scripts/source_ros2_uv.sh && echo '[task-start] _terminal/cancel' && echo '[task-ready] _terminal/cancel' && echo 'ROS2 cancel terminal: e.g. ros2 run motion_control cancel_goal; ros2 param set /hardware_bridge enabled false' && exec bash -i

tasks.label: run/reset-service
args: echo '[task-start] run/reset-service'; echo '[task-ready] run/reset-service'; exec ./scripts/run_ros2_uv.sh ros2 run motion_control reset_service --ros-args --params-file ./ros2_ws/src/motion_control/config/FinsROV/traditional_pid_position_yaw.yaml

tasks.label: run/grpc-ros-adapter-sim
args: echo '[task-start] run/grpc-ros-adapter-sim'; source ./scripts/source_ros2_uv.sh; echo '[task-ready] run/grpc-ros-adapter-sim'; exec ./scripts/launch_grpc_ros_adapter.sh topic_prefix:=/sim
